ns2:section.sectionText: The recent growth in structured and unstructured data combined with sophisticated techniques for leveraging these data for decision-making, creates huge opportunities for marketers. This course introduces key concepts in marketing analytics and shows how analytics can help solve real-world marketing problems. Covered topics include data scraping, text analysis, data visualization, machine learning, causal and predictive models. Each technique is implemented using "mini cases" in R programming with unique datasets from a variety of marketing contexts.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS: Technology Management-UIUC, MS:Business Analytics - UIUC, or MS:Management -UIUC.
